description: Source code for a configurable RSSI LED control daemon for OpenWrt, managing LED indicators based on Wi-Fi signal quality.

classes.name: led
classes.description: Represents an LED with sysfs path, control file descriptor, and current state.

classes.name: rule
classes.description: Defines rules for LED behavior based on Wi-Fi quality metrics.

methods.name: log_rules
methods.description: Logs the current set of rules to syslog.

methods.name: set_led
methods.description: Sets the LED to a specified brightness value.

methods.name: init_led
methods.description: Initializes an LED by opening its sysfs brightness control file.

methods.name: close_led
methods.description: Closes and frees resources associated with an LED.

methods.name: quality
methods.description: Retrieves the current Wi-Fi quality percentage.

methods.name: open_backend
methods.description: Opens the Wi-Fi info backend for a given interface.

methods.name: update_leds
methods.description: Updates LED states based on current quality and rules.
